lines.t: My child, I know you deeply,
You are never lost to Me.
I saw you in the shadows,
But I knew who you would be.
Those failures kept in memory...
I don’t hold a single one.
In the space dead works filled up,
stand all the works I’ve done.
You fear what I remember,
but I recall no single stain.
I remembered you on Calvary...
now you breathe the Life I gave.
I keep what I know…
I keep you, not what you’ve done.
I hold what remains…
when the fire has had its run.
Ashes fall behind you,
but gold is all I claim...
For I keep what is Mine,
you are sealed apart from blame..
Your robes of reputation
and the efforts that you fed.
The well-kept righteous moments
were lifeless, pale, and dead.
All tidy, shining virtues
were walls you tried to climb...
But only My own righteousness
can pass the test of time.
You thought good intentions
were all that held My grace...
But child, it’s My perfection
that now stands in your place.
I keep what I know…
I keep you, not what you’ve done.
I hold what remains…
when the fire has had its run.
Ashes fall behind you,
but gold is all I claim...
For I keep what is Mine,
and you are sealed in My name.
Dead works have turned to ashes,
Human effort has blown away
For neither could deliver
your heart from its own sway.
But everything I planted
endures through storm and flame…
And what remains within you
now blossoms in My name.
I keep what I know…
but it’s you, not what you’ve done.
I hold what remains…
when the fire has had its run.
Ashes fall behind us.
but gold is all I claim...
My beloved, you are Mine,
and you are sealed in My name.
